title: Robotics Engineer Freshers
description:
**Company Description**

Playto Labs is an early-stage angel funded startup by IIT Kanpur alumni, working to get kids future ready through play. Playto Labs is an e-learning platform that provides hands-on learning experiences in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) for students aged 7 years and above. The platform offers practical courses and projects designed to help students develop technical knowledge, creativity, and problem-solving skills. View more details here: www.playtolabs.com

 **Job Description**

Role Overview

We are looking for passionate Robotics Engineers who enjoy teaching and mentoring students through online sessions. The candidate will conduct online robotics classes for children aged 8–16 years and mentor both Indian and international students on Robotics, Arduino, IoT, AI basics, and STEM-related projects.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct online Robotics and STEM classes for students aged 8–16 years Teach Arduino, IoT, sensors, electronics, and automation concepts  
Mentor Indian and international students through interactive online sessions Guide students in robotics projects and innovation challenges

Prepare students for national and international robotics competitions Support students as a mentor during competitions and project presentations Create engaging and hands-on learning experiences in virtual classrooms Troubleshoot technical issues related to robotics projects and coding

Required Skills

Basic knowledge of Robotics, Arduino, IoT, and Electronics Strong communication and teaching skills  
Basic programming knowledge in C/C++ or Python Passion for mentoring young students

Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities  
Comfortable conducting online classes and interactive sessions

 **Qualifications**

Any BE, BTech Degree (Any Stream) – Only Freshers candidates can apply.

 **Additional Information**

Opportunity to mentor students globally  
Exposure to national and international robotics competitions  
Hands-on experience with Robotics and AI technologies  
Career growth opportunities in EdTech and Robotics
